name: Admin Accounting Receivables Forecast
description: Superuser controls a global manual collection forecast from the 'Pendiente por cobrar' card on /panel/accounting. The card total is the sum of original amounts for selected, open, expected company incomes classified green/high. Its modal reads GET /api/accounting/receivables/ and exposes three tabs: totals and rows grouped by green/high, orange/medium, red/low and unclassified; a flat selected summary; and management of all open expected company candidates. Candidate management opens grouped by client, can regroup by project or switch to a classic flat list, and shows original, paid and open totals for each group. This presentation resets to client grouping whenever the modal opens. Candidate toggles and traffic-light confidence changes PATCH independently, assigning a color preserves the manual switch, and a failed request leaves a visible retry action. Floating help remains inside the modal overlay so its complete traffic-light legend is readable. A soft circle accompanies the full green/high, orange/medium, red/low or neutral/unclassified label in the modal, expected-income list, create/edit form and income detail.
